verdict.rationale: Thoropass's only documented programmatic surface is its official MCP server. It covers a narrow slice of the UI: listing audits and audit details, listing evidence requests with their linked systems, and adding comments, attachments and status updates to evidence requests. There is no evidence of a general public API, and much of the UI's functionality has no documented programmatic equivalent. That includes risk register, policies, access reviews, monitors, controls and user management. missing for 10: a documented public REST/GraphQL API, API coverage of risk register/policies/access reviews/monitors/controls/admin functions, an explicit UI-parity claim, independent corroboration.
